name: BL-050 momentum filter POC: six filters on the frozen Broad ensemble
source: backlog/BL-050-momentum-filter-poc.md - the plan; this file is the machine-readable copy of its rules and holds the exact formulas
rule: Committed before any BL-050 feature computation, screen or backtest. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file (bl050_criteria_addendum_N.json) that names what it supersedes and why. Code reads these values and never restates them.
owner_approved: 2026-10-08, answers to the start questions recorded in BL-050 (tilt weight 0.25; pick-level tilt; tighter statistical bar; two CLI shadow arms)
hypothesis: At least one of V1, V2, R1, M1, M2, T1, applied the same way to all four frozen configs, raises the ensemble's after-cost CAGR robustly across rolling windows without worsening its drawdown.

universe.membership: liquidity.turnover_rank_members_by_year, as known each January (top 750 by median daily turnover in July-December of the year before)
universe.liquidity: the frozen gate in bl010_phase6_frozen.json fixed_settings (liq_*)
universe.delisted: kept in their historical years; a series that ends is valued at its last real close
universe.cross_section: Any cross-sectional step (percentile, quintile, decile) uses only that week's stock_membership (PIT member AND liquidity pass), stock columns only. Never all columns of the price frame: it also holds names that are members only in later years.
universe.atomics: ATOMIC_NAMES (Gold, Silver, Nasdaq 100, Hang Seng) are never gated and get a neutral (0.5) feature percentile

comparator.ensemble: choose.ensemble_curve over the four configs (equal capital, reset at the last week before each 1 April)
comparator.overrides: only start and end, set to the window being tested; every other setting exactly as frozen

data.prices: the adjusted weekly closes the engine trades (UniverseRanking.prices: split/bonus back-adjusted, price-only, no dividends)
data.turnover: bars_1d_stock.turnover (rupees), rows with synthetic_close = true excluded; a split segment column (SYMBOL#2) reads its base symbol's turnover
data.week_label: W-FRI: a session belongs to the week ending on its Friday (sources.weekly), the same label as the prices and the liquidity gate
data.benchmark: reference_benchmarks.NIFTY500_TRI weekly close, matched to the stock weeks by exact W-FRI label with no carry-forward; a missing week makes R1 and M2 missing for that week (counted in the results)
data.known_bias: Nifty 500 TRI includes dividends and the stock prices do not, so R1 is biased against stocks by about half the index dividend yield over 26 weeks. Accepted; no new data.

tilt.mechanism: Category selection runs exactly as frozen on the untouched combined_pool_ranks. Inside each held category, the picks_per_category picks are the names with the highest blended = 0.75 * momentum_pct + 0.25 * feature_pct (ties by pool rank). momentum_pct = 1 - (combined_pool_rank - 1) / (N - 1) over that week's pool; feature_pct = the feature's percentile rank over that week's pool stocks with a value, oriented so 1.0 is best; a missing feature counts as 0.5. The config's own stock_tilt then applies unchanged on top. A held name that stops being a pick loses its rank and is sold, as today.
tilt.default: off; with the hook off every result is byte-identical

gate.mechanism: run_broad_backtest(extra_no_buy=mask): blocks fresh buys only, never forces a sale; a blocked pick's slot goes to the next buyable slot in the engine's rank order

V1.formula: median(daily turnover, last 20 sessions up to and including the decision Friday) / median(daily turnover, last 130 sessions)

V2.formula: over the last 13 weeks (t-12..t): sum of weekly turnover in weeks whose adjusted weekly return > 0 / sum of weekly turnover in weeks whose return < 0; flat weeks ignored; weekly turnover = sum of that week's daily turnover

R1.formula: blocked when P_t / P_(t-26) - 1 <= TRI_t / TRI_(t-26) - 1

M1.formula: ext = P_t / mean(P_(t-9..t)); blocked when ext >= the 0.95 quantile (linear) of ext over that week's stock_membership names with a value

M2.formula: OLS of the stock's weekly return on Nifty 500 TRI's weekly return over weeks t-51..t (intercept included); residuals e over that window; M2 = sum(e over t-29..t-4) / std(e over t-51..t, ddof 1)

T1.formula: OLS of ln(P) on the week index over t-25..t; T1 = slope * 52 * R^2

lookahead_checks: Every feature at week t uses sessions and closes up to and including the decision Friday t only; signal_delay = 1 is unchanged.

Prefix invariance, per feature: at 24 decision Fridays sampled evenly over the development window, the value computed from raw daily bars cut at that Friday, with turnover_rank membership and the liquidity gate rebuilt from the cut data, equals the full-data value (relative tolerance 1e-9; M1 and R1 compare the block booleans). Slicing the weekly frame is not enough: it cannot catch a universe leak.
M1's percentile uses that week's stock_membership only (see universe.cross_section).
M2 and T1 regressions use trailing windows only.
Nifty 500 TRI is matched by exact week, never carried forward.
Screen forward returns start at the fill week t+1, not the decision week.
Nothing reads a bar dated on or after windows.holdout.from before the one hold-out run (a guard refuses it), and no development forward return ends after windows.development.to.

holdout.status: reserved, not unseen: the frozen configs were selected on data through 2026-10, and 3.9.23 ran relatives of T1 and M1 over it
holdout.claim_file: search_spaces/bl050_holdout_result.json, written before the run reads any hold-out bar

windows.plain: Development reads no bar on or after 2024-01-01. A screen decision at Friday t needs t + 14 weeks <= 2023-12-29 (one fill week + 13 forward weeks).

closest_relatives.T1: smoothness gate (levers.choppy_mask), rejected on Broad, median -5.9
closest_relatives.M1: near the inverse of the 52-week-high gate (levers.below_high52_mask), marginal
closest_relatives.R1: a relative cousin of the cash hurdle (defensive='filter'), rejected twice

score.why: the frozen configs use three different scores; this one is shared by two of the four (1281e8ed6824, bad83df3821a)

phase_2_screen.decision_weeks: Fridays whose week number since engine.CADENCE_EPOCH (2016-01-01) is 0 mod 4, from the first such Friday on or after 2012-01-01 through the last t with t + 14 weeks <= 2023-12-29
phase_2_screen.candidates: the top quintile by score among that week's stock_membership names with a score, split into its two momentum deciles

split.tilt: inside each decile, names with a feature value split at the decile's median feature: better half (by the pre-registered direction) vs worse half
split.gate: inside each decile, blocked vs passed

phase_2_screen.return: adjusted weekly close from Friday t+1 (the fill week, signal_delay 1) to Friday t+1+h, minus a 0.3% round trip; a series that ends inside the horizon earns its return to its last real close
phase_2_screen.cost_note: the round trip is subtracted from both sides, so it cancels in the spread; stated so the returns are after cost, not as a test
phase_2_screen.weekly_statistic: sum over the two deciles of n_d * (mean_better_d - mean_worse_d) / sum n_d, where n_d is the smaller half's count (tilts) or the blocked count (gates); for gates, better = passed and worse = blocked
phase_2_screen.test: one-sided t on the weekly statistic series in the pre-registered direction, Newey-West standard errors, lags = ceil(h / 4) (13 weeks: 4; 4 weeks: 1)
phase_2_screen.multiple_testing: Holm across the 6 features at the 13-week horizon, alpha 0.05; the 4-week results are reported only

minimum_sample.below: inconclusive - treated as not passing; reported, never tuned

reported: per gate: names blocked per decision week (mean, median, max) and block rate among candidates
per feature: correlation with the momentum score inside the top quintile
phase_2_screen.pass: the 13-week test survives Holm and its mean is in the pre-registered direction, with the minimum sample met
phase_2_screen.killed: stops here, except as a PBO trial in Phase 3 (where it cannot pass)

phase_3_engine_test.runs: all 6 features through all 4 frozen configs (gates via extra_no_buy, tilts via the pick-level hook), each ensembled with choose.ensemble_curve; plus the comparator

rolling.method: sweep.rolling_windows over the development weeks; each window a fresh run from its start (sweep.rerun_windows), comparator and trial both

pbo.on: weekly log returns of the 7 ensemble curves (6 trials + comparator), development window

phase_3_engine_test.also_must: pass phase_2_screen; a feature killed there cannot pass here
reported: gate substitutions: blocked buys and what filled the slot

phase_3_holdout.enters: every feature that passed phase_3_engine_test, all in the one run
phase_3_holdout.why_weaker: short window, and in-sample for the frozen base configs; Phase 4 is the deciding test

phase_4_forward_shadow.arms: one per hold-out survivor (owner, 2026-10-08); each arm = the four frozen configs plus that filter, saved as four favourites, never the active (Telegram) favourite
phase_4_forward_shadow.starts: the first Friday after the arm's favourites are saved
phase_4_forward_shadow.journal: BL-024 forward journal, next to the frozen ensemble; neither is changed
phase_4_forward_shadow.display: CLI only (mbt journal show, the tracker)
phase_4_forward_shadow.compared_over: the arm's recorded weeks, against the frozen ensemble over the same weeks
pass_all_of: shadow max drawdown no more than 3 pts worse
no live-rule breach (live_rules.toml) that the ensemble did not also hit
phase_4_forward_shadow.adoption: a separate owner decision under BL-025 (paper first, then money); never automatic

will_not_run: market-wide trend, breadth or choppiness gates (rejected in 3.9.23)
ADX (daily highs/lows are not split-adjusted; overlaps T1)
RS momentum / the RRG axis (reduces to a lookback)
a second setting or weight for any feature
a tilt at the slot level (stock_tilt-style) or the pool level
a screen on any other score
anything that reads a bar on or after 2024-01-01 before the hold-out run
exclusions or thresholds added after seeing results
